The Harbor Cruise runs every day at 17:00, so today's sailing is on. If it's still before 17:00 where you are, you can make it. I can't see the local time from here, so check your clock.

The weather looks good for it. It's 21°C now, with light wind (about 8 km/h) and no rain.

I don't have the boarding cutoff or the seat availability. I'd suggest arriving well before 17:00 and asking the front desk to confirm there's space and when boarding closes. I can also help you plan the rest of your evening around the cruise.
